intro.title: Auto captions
intro.text: Turn what is said into captions that follow every word, burnt into your Short and sent to 3Speak as subtitles too.
intro.unavailable: Auto captions are not available on this editor server right now. Your Short renders as usual without them.

presetHints.karaoke: A few words at a time, the word being said in the highlight colour
presetHints.pop: One word (or a few) at a time, popping in
presetHints.plain: Classic subtitle lines on a dark box

style.title: Style
style.burn: Show in the video (off: only as subtitles on 3Speak)

words.title: Words ({{n}})
words.hint: Fix what was misheard; clear a word to drop it. Moved or cut clips? Run Auto captions again.

job.noTracks: There is no speech to caption: add a clip with sound first.
job.lost: The captions job was lost (the server restarted?)
job.noSpeech: No speech found. Is the voice on an audio track that is not muted (music tracks are left out)?
